name: PMFBY Grievance API Attributes
privacy_notes: applicantPhone is personal data. It travels inbound only and is never echoed in a response; on_init returns the masked otpChallenge.sentTo instead.
otp is marked writeOnly. It must never be returned in a response, written to a log, attached to a trace, or forwarded to the lodge call.
applicationNo identifies a named farmer's insurance policy and should not be logged in payload dumps.
grievanceDescription is free text written by a farmer and may contain personal details the schema cannot constrain.

The portal's case record carries far more about the farmer than this pack surfaces -- name, mobile number, email, and the full state / district / sub-district / panchayat / village hierarchy, alongside the insurance policy number and insurer. The adapter must drop all of it and map only the fields named here; none of it may reach commitmentAttributes, a log, or a trace.
